en.title: GTA 6 Honors Iconic GTA 4 Meme with New Scooter Brothers Mechanic
en.summary: A beloved inside joke from Grand Theft Auto 4's early days has officially transcended meme status and is now a core mechanic in the highly anticipated GTA 6. Rockstar Games is bringing back the 'scooter brothers' concept in a significant way.
en.body:
For years, Grand Theft Auto fans have cherished the absurdly funny "scooter brothers" moment from a 2008 GTA 4 stream. A player, riding a moped, encounters another moped rider and hilariously declares them "scooter brothers." This clip, boasting over 7.5 million views on YouTube, became an enduring piece of GTA lore. Now, Rockstar Games is not only acknowledging this fan-favorite meme but embedding it directly into the gameplay of **Grand Theft Auto 6**.

Recent previews, including one from Edge magazine, have revealed that players will be able to summon their vehicles using a new in-game app. This app is aptly named "Scooter Brothers." Upon use, an NPC will deliver your requested car, then hop onto a scooter – presumably operated by another "brother" – and ride off. This mechanic offers a practical way to retrieve your customized vehicles, especially considering that weapons and essential gear are reportedly stored in the car trunk in **GTA 6**. It suggests a shift towards making player vehicles more integral and less disposable than in previous installments. While **GTA Online** and **Red Dead Redemption** have offered similar vehicle summoning features, this marks the first time such a system will be available without cheats in a mainline Grand Theft Auto single-player experience.

## A Nod to the Past

This isn't the first time Rockstar has paid homage to the "scooter brothers" meme. In **Grand Theft Auto 5**, players could occasionally witness Trevor Philips recreating the scene with a bewildered NPC. However, the integration into **GTA 6** feels more substantial and purposeful. It demonstrates Rockstar's commitment to acknowledging and rewarding the community's engagement with the series' history. The developers have a keen understanding of what resonates with their player base, and this mechanic is a prime example of weaving fan-favorite moments into the fabric of a new world. The inclusion also hints at potentially more lighthearted NPC interactions and emergent gameplay possibilities, adding another layer of personality to **GTA 6**'s already vibrant world.

## What Fans Can Expect

The confirmation of the "Scooter Brothers" app is a delightful detail for long-time fans who remember the original meme. It adds a layer of charm and continuity to the **Grand Theft Auto** series. The practicality of the mechanic, ensuring easy access to your arsenal and personal vehicles, also suggests that Rockstar is thinking deeply about player convenience and immersion in **GTA 6**. It’s a move that balances humor with utility, a hallmark of the **Grand Theft Auto** experience. Whether these NPC "scooter brothers" will deliver their own quirky lines to further honor the meme's origins remains to be seen, but the potential for memorable interactions is high.

## The Road Ahead

With **Grand Theft Auto 6**’s launch just three weeks away, these gameplay details are arriving at a rapid pace. Pre-loading is set to begin two weeks before the official release, and Rockstar's global marketing push is in full swing. While a PC version's existence is heavily rumored, official details are still pending.

content_raw: GTA 6 has named one of its biggest mechanics after a beloved GTA 4 meme. In 2008, a Justin.tv channel (now known as Twitch) by the name of FourPlayerPodcast made GTA history. One of the hosts of the channel, Brad Simons, rode a moped around GTA 4's Liberty City. He eventually found another moped rider and began comically declaring them "scooter brothers." The video has over 7.5 million views on YouTube , and now it's part of GTA 6. In a new preview from Edge magazine , it was confirmed that players will be able to summon their vehicle using an app called Scooter Brothers. An NPC will deliver your car and then get on a scooter (presumably driven by another "brother") and drive off. Whether or not these so-called scooter brothers will have their own silly lines to honor their origins remains to be seen. In GTA 5, when switching to Trevor, players would have a chance of seeing the wily character recreating the meme with a frightened NPC. It was a pretty great nod, and now, Rockstar is keeping the tradition alive, though this time with more purpose. GTA Online has had a mechanic to let you call your car since launch, and Red Dead Redemption also allows you to summon your horse if it's within a reasonable distance. However, this is the first time players will be able to do something like this without cheats in GTA's single-player. It's arguably more necessary than ever, too, as the player's arsenal of weapons and some other important gear is stored in the trunk of their vehicle. It also means your cars likely won't be as disposable as they were in previous games. All of this news comes just three weeks ahead of GTA 6's launch and two weeks before pre-loading begins. Rockstar's marketing efforts are ramping up across the globe . Rumors also indicate a PC version of the game is just around the corner, with a reported release window of early 2027 . Either way, it's an exciting time to be a GTA fan.
